context: The agent must provision a new cloud resource, with an existing Crossplane Managed Resource given as the pattern. Key discriminator: without the idiom, an agent may reach for Terraform (a new .tf file with a google_storage_bucket resource) since that's the industry-standard reflex for 'provision cloud infrastructure'; with the idiom loaded, it knows Queenswood provisions everything via Crossplane Managed Resources applied by Argo CD, so the bucket is declared as Kubernetes-native YAML matching the sibling resource's shape, never a Terraform file.

checklist.name: Declared as a Crossplane Managed Resource
checklist.description: widget-bucket.yaml has a kind representing a storage bucket with a GCP upjet-provider apiVersion, matching vpc.yaml's family

checklist.name: No Terraform file introduced
checklist.description: The diff does not add a .tf file or any google_storage_bucket Terraform resource

checklist.name: providerConfigRef matches the existing pattern
checklist.description: widget-bucket.yaml references the same providerConfigRef name as vpc.yaml
